what_happened.line: School Committee voted unanimously to appoint Dr. Susan Gilson to the finance director position, pending a signed contract with the superintendent.
The appointment followed a superintendent-led screening that narrowed the field of candidates before a second round of review with finance consultants.
A committee member noted the district had gone through the recent budget season and contract negotiations without a finance director in place.
The committee then voted to move into executive session to interview applicants for other openings.

why_it_matters: The finance director oversees the school department's budget and payroll functions, a post that sat vacant through a budget cycle and contract talks.
Final appointment still depends on contract terms being agreed with the superintendent, not yet finalized as of this meeting.
The chair also flagged that week's town election, which included an override question relevant to school funding.

Official minutes also record procedural detail (who made/seconded the motion, the chair's report, absent/recording-secretary attendees) that our caption-derived minutes omit entirely.
